report: Infantile-onset Blaschko-linear verrucous plaques, winter worsening, biopsy (hyperkeratosis, acanthosis, papillomatosis, focal epidermolytic hyperkeratosis) support systematized epidermal nevus (0.85). Male sex, no neonatal vesicles, extracutaneous features or seasonality refute incontinentia pigmenti; no blistering/redness makes epidermolytic ichthyosis unlikely. Epidermal nevus syndrome remains possible but low (0.15) without extracutaneous involvement; thus, systematized epidermal nevus.
